3b067bdf76c406e54ec81dfe29ac81fda80a3d91.definition: The use of pressure, ambiguity or emotion to move a person into a decision that does not serve them, without giving a real choice.
3b067bdf76c406e54ec81dfe29ac81fda80a3d91.gloss: The use of pressure, ambiguity or emotion to move a person into a decision that does not serve them, without giving a real choice.

3b067bdf76c406e54ec81dfe29ac81fda80a3d91.definition: 圧力、曖昧な言い方、感情の動揺などを使って、相手が本当に選びたくない選択をさせる手法。本当な選択肢は残されないことが多い。
3b067bdf76c406e54ec81dfe29ac81fda80a3d91.gloss: 圧力や曖昧さ、感情で、相手のためにならない選択へ導く手法。

3b067bdf76c406e54ec81dfe29ac81fda80a3d91.definition: 압박, 모호한 말이나 감정을 이용해 상대가 자신에게 불리한 결정을 하도록 유도하는 행위다.
3b067bdf76c406e54ec81dfe29ac81fda80a3d91.gloss: 진정한 선택의 여지를 남기지 않고 상대가 원하지 않는 결정을 내리게 하는 조작.

3b067bdf76c406e54ec81dfe29ac81fda80a3d91.definition: É a prática de influenciar a escolha de alguém por meio de pressão, ambiguidade ou apelo emocional, sem lhe apresentar uma alternativa genuína. Pode envolver esconder informações ou tornar uma opção impossível.
3b067bdf76c406e54ec81dfe29ac81fda80a3d91.gloss: Uso de pressão, ambiguidade ou emoção para levar alguém a uma decisão que não lhe conviene, sem oferecer uma escolha real.

3b067bdf76c406e54ec81dfe29ac81fda80a3d91.definition: Cara memengaruhi keputusan seseorang sehingga pilihan yang ditawarkan tidak benar-benar pilihan. Berbeda dari persuasi, manipulasi menekan atau mengaburkan pilihan sehingga orang tidak dapat menolak dengan bebas.
3b067bdf76c406e54ec81dfe29ac81fda80a3d91.gloss: Penggunaan tekanan, ambiguitas, atau emosi untuk mengarahkan keputusan seseorang tanpa pilihan yang sebenarnya.

3b067bdf76c406e54ec81dfe29ac81fda80a3d91.definition: การใช้แรงกดดัน ความกำกวม หรืออารมณ์เพื่อให้บุคคลตัดสินใจในสิ่งที่ไม่เป็นผลประโยชน์ของพวกเขา ขณะทำให้รู้สึกว่าไม่มีทางเลือกจริง
3b067bdf76c406e54ec81dfe29ac81fda80a3d91.gloss: การชักจูงเพื่อให้ตัดสินใจโดยไม่มีทางเลือกจริง

3b067bdf76c406e54ec81dfe29ac81fda80a3d91.definition: Bir kişinin gerçek bir seçim yapmasına izin vermeden baskı, belirsizlik veya duygusal etkiyle yönlendirilmesi. Seçenekler görünürde sunulsa bile biri fiilen imkânsız hâle getirilebilir.
3b067bdf76c406e54ec81dfe29ac81fda80a3d91.gloss: Manipülasyon: Bir kişiyi baskı, belirsizlik ya da duygusal yollarla kendi çıkarına uygun olmayan bir karara yönlendirmek.
